name: pattern
description: Search for structural AST patterns or node kinds across files in the workspace (Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, C, C++). Supports Tree-Sitter query syntax (e.g. `(call_expression function: (identifier) @call)`) or AST node kind matching (e.g. `impl_item`, `function_definition`, `struct_specifier`).

pattern.description: Tree-sitter query S-expression (e.g. `(call_expression function: (identifier) @call)`) or an AST node kind name (e.g. `impl_item`, `function_definition`, `struct_specifier`).

path.description: Directory or file path to search within. Defaults to the current workspace root.

language.description: Optional language filter: rust, typescript, javascript, python, go, c, cpp.
